items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I worked a few months with Benny, and the time I was with him, Slam Stewart was with him, and Red Norvo was with him same time I was with him. Who else was with him? He had a big band.

ctx.x: Well, they didn't want us. So, Teddy approached Benny. He says -- he said, we have a problem here. We can't get a room in the hotel. He said, we though you made

a reservation. Benny said -- then he says they don't want to let us have a room. So, Benny didn't go to the front for this, you know. He said you know I have problems too. I can't belong to this Jewish club, this club or that one because I'm Jewish.
